title: Excellent Quality
body: The amla powder is very fine and pure. I've been taking it daily with warm water and can see a difference in my digestion.

title: Good taste, slightly different
body: The taste is good and you can tell it's raw and unprocessed. A bit less sweet than normal honey which is what I wanted.

title: Energy Booster!
body: Great addition to my morning smoothies. I feel much more energetic throughout the day. Will definitely reorder.
